case_fields.subject_group: pseudonymous grouping for splitting repeated cases
case_fields.evaluated_at: time for which an interpretation is requested
case_fields.evidence_available_until: cutoff to prevent using later observations in earlier predictions
case_fields.natal_context: observed natal facts; retain unknown fields

time_context.daewoon: select explicitly supplied source-labelled [start,end) period; age-only L1 schedule is not converted into start dates
time_context.yearly: canonical L1 year pillar at evaluated_at, using solar-term boundary
time_context.monthly: canonical L1 month pillar at evaluated_at, using solar-term boundary

case_fields.features: observed degree in [0,1] or null, with measurement policy and source
case_fields.interactions: explicit factors involving 2 or more features; arbitrary arity supported
case_fields.target: precise definition of the interpretation being modelled
case_fields.label: reviewed degree or binary outcome depending on declared target; no implicit label
case_fields.label_origin: expert/source annotation/empirical outcome must remain distinguishable

mapping_to_current_engine: chart_context.mjs exports L1 natal and time observations; context_query.py evaluates 8 reviewed antecedents and supplies features to conditional_model.predict when a compatible model is explicitly supplied. This research CLI is not connected to application inference.

implemented_observation_request.birth: canonical L1 Gregorian fields; explicit hour integer 0..23 or null; known minute is forbidden with unknown hour
implemented_observation_request.evaluated_at: required ISO timestamp with UTC offset and whole-minute precision
implemented_observation_request.daewoon_periods: optional array of {start,end,pillar,source}; pillar is sexagenary index 0..59; overlapping periods are rejected; no active period means unknown
implemented_observation_request.unknown_hour: enumerate valid civil minutes, retain consensus and measurement bounds; never substitute noon or average the scenarios; timezone transition dates remain unresolved
implemented_observation_request.features: categorical presence 0/1/null; unweighted stem/branch fractions over 4 slots and surface-element fractions over 8 slots; day-master-relative wealth/authority and hidden-stem presence; temporal symbols and stem ten-gods; centered-pair samhap completion
implemented_observation_request.condition_values: exact reviewed antecedents only, three-valued logic; condition match is not a personal interpretation or probability
implemented_observation_request.model_compatibility: require feature_policy plus identical review_sha256, adapter_sha256 and calculator_files; retain request and source provenance
implemented_observation_request.not_implemented: strength/root weighting, birth-derived precise daewoon start dates, learned labels/parameters, empirical calibration, time-transition learning

implemented_review_workflow.schema: case_review_pilot.json demonstrates version-1 spec, cases, provenance, annotations and split; its six calculator fixtures are not training cases
implemented_review_workflow.target_kind: literature_applicability only; structural predicates are audited separately and empirical outcome targets are rejected
implemented_review_workflow.labels: reviewed binary/soft labels with reviewer, rationale, time, declared expert origin and evidence references; pending/unknown/disputed stay null
implemented_review_workflow.source_and_subject_split: transitive grouping by source family, subject, dependency groups, input evidence hashes and normalized copied requests; excluded rows remain in dependency graph
implemented_review_workflow.time: input evidence available by case evaluation; annotation not before input evidence; optional forward split also checks target/case/annotation availability before train_until
implemented_review_workflow.comparison: same eligible cases, raw observations, split and optimizer; additive logistic versus explicitly declared multiway products; no automatic winner
implemented_review_workflow.provenance_limits: declared identities, timestamps and external evidence hashes are not authenticated by the code
implemented_review_workflow.current_learning_status: no eligible real cases or trained production parameters supplied

implemented_source_case_workflow.input_mode: source_reported_pillars, distinct from Gregorian calculator requests
implemented_source_case_workflow.provenance: repository DOCX hash, paragraph hash, exact substring offsets, symbol anchors and explicit position-reading notes
implemented_source_case_workflow.unknown: unreported pillars, transit boundaries and evaluated_at remain null; no cross-passage filling or transit union
implemented_source_case_workflow.author_assertions: source explanations only, never independent expert labels or observed outcomes
implemented_source_case_workflow.dependencies: source family, subject, declared dependencies and shared source file hashes; identities are not authenticated
implemented_source_case_workflow.current_scope: 6 literature cases, 4 DOCX, 32 excerpts; 0 training eligible; no matched case for the current eul/fire target
